integrity: Universal integral proof from deletion-link homotopy cofibration and checked path-to-cycle inclusion maps; 28 bounded mod-two checks used only as corroboration. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Single bridge joining exactly two simple cycles; no claims for longer connectors or general cactus graphs. Finite mod-two verification does not establish the infinite integral theorem. Equivalent unindexed literature may exist.
title: Bridge-sensitive homotopy classification of two-cycle matching complexes
